name: held_save_decided
about: The step's first reply reads the note back and saves in the same reply. The save is refused and held. The caller corrects the note and hangs up while the step only acknowledges it. The call's end asks the step once, finish or not_yet, on what the caller said, and saves the corrected note, unconfirmed.
instructions: You help callers with their orders.

tasks.name: take_note
tasks.when: The caller wants to leave a note.

turns.caller: Please note that I want a call back.

model.text: Your note: a call back. Is that right?

spoken: Your note: a call back. Is that right?

turns.caller: No, make it an email instead. Bye.
